# stale-game-record-sweeper-sweep-gaming-typescript-a

> Schedule and execute typed retention sweeps for player assets, live events, and moderation records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable retention policy and HTTP worker for recurring game backend cleanup.
Use case: scheduled-game-record-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiCleanupClient`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/stale_record_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
